approved: Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2015

The member moved the Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2015, requiring the Treasurer to table Regional Australia Statements with each budget and Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook. The bill aims to ensure government policies assess their economic, social, cultural and environmental impacts on regional Australia, citing the 2014-15 budget's omission of such a statement and its disproportionate effects on areas like Wodonga, Wangaratta, Benalla and Alexandra.
